top_signals.title: Don Wilson on the GPU Market’s Trillion Dollar Question
top_signals.summary: When we spoke to Don Wilson, founder and CEO of DRW, in Chicago last year, he told us he wanted to build a market for GPUs that would eventually be bigger than oil. A year’s time in the age of AI is an eternity, and so for the first episode of this year’s Chicago live show - recorded at City Winery - Wilson joins us on stage again to talk about what’s changed and what hasn’t in his quest to help build this market. top_signals.title: The Pentagon Doesn’t Need to Reinvent Supply Chain Transparency
top_signals.summary:
As the United States seeks to rebuild its defense industrial base, Washington is scrambling to understand an industrial ecosystem that it no longer controls, nor largely understands. China has been able to achieve strategic advantage against the United States through the targeted application of export controls and licensing requirements on specific materials at specific supply chain nodes. U.S. responses, by contrast, have largely been broader in scope and shallower in effect.
